title: Edmonton police officer ruled justified in fatal shooting of teenager
article: A unit that investigates incidents involving police says an Edmonton officer was justified in shooting a teenager who charged at him.
Seventeen-year-old Cyrus Green died Feb. 4 when he was shot three times in the chest.
Police were responding to a report of a mugging at the light-rail transit station near Rexall Place.
The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team says the officer was acting in self defence and will not be charged.
ASIRT's report also says Green was drunk and under the influence of marijuana.
He told police officers they would have to shoot him before he charged at them with a baseball bat and hunting knife.
